info.name: Veeam Backup for AWS public API 1.0 Agents Jobs API

params.name: skip
params.description: Number of jobs to skip.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of jobs to return.

params.name: orderColumn
params.description: Sorts jobs by one of the job parameters.

params.name: orderAsc
params.description: Sorts jobs in the ascending order by the `orderColumn` parameter.

params.name: nameFilter
params.description: Filters jobs by the `nameFilter` pattern. The pattern can match any job parameter. To substitute one or more characters, use the asterisk (*) character at the beginning, at the end or both.

params.name: typeFilter
params.description: Filters jobs by job type.

items.docs: The HTTP GET request to the `/api/v1/jobs` path allows you to get an array of all jobs coordinated by the backup server.
The HTTP POST request to the `/api/v1/jobs` path allows you to create a new job that has the specified parameters.

params.name: skip
params.description: Number of job states to skip.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of job states to return.

params.name: orderColumn
params.description: Sorts job states by one of the state parameters.

params.name: orderAsc
params.description: Sorts job states in the ascending order by the `orderColumn` parameter.

params.name: idFilter
params.description: Filters job states by job ID.

params.name: nameFilter
params.description: Filters job states by the `nameFilter` pattern. The pattern can match any state parameter. To substitute one or more characters, use the asterisk (*) character at the beginning, at the end or both.

params.name: typeFilter
params.description: Filters job states by job type.

params.name: lastResultFilter
params.description: Filters job states by status with which jobs must finish.

params.name: statusFilter
params.description: Filters job states by current status of the job.

params.name: workloadFilter
params.description: Filters job states by workloads that jobs must process.

params.name: lastRunAfterFilter
params.description: Returns job states for jobs that have run after the specified date and time.

params.name: lastRunBeforeFilter
params.description: Returns job states for jobs that have not run after the specified date and time.

params.name: isHighPriorityJobFilter
params.description: If *true*, Returns job states for jobs with high priority.

params.name: repositoryIdFilter
params.description: Filters job states by repository ID.

params.name: objectsCountFilter
params.description: Filters job states by number of objects processed by the job.

items.docs: The HTTP GET request to the `/api/v1/jobs/states` path allows you to get an array of all job states. The states include brief job information that you can also find under the **Jobs** node in the Veeam Backup & Replication console.

params.name: id
params.description: ID of the job.

items.docs: The HTTP GET request to the `/api/v1/jobs/{id}` path allows you to get a job that has the specified `id`.

items.docs: The HTTP PUT request to the `/api/v1/jobs/{id}` path allows you to edit a job that has the specified `id`.
